Package pong

package pong
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Ball
    The ball(s) the players hit back and forth Normal balls reset to the middle after a goal.
    Image
     
    MusicPlayer
    Plays looping background music using Java's Clip (I used afplay before in my g11 final project, but that only works on Mac)
    Paddle
    A player's paddle that moves up and down with the keys and can't go off the screen Powerups can make it bigger, faster or slower, and the Buddha palm stretches it over the whole field
    Pong
    The main game, runs the 2 minute Pong match and everything that happens in it Besides normal Pong there's powerup rolls, Zetamac math duels that fire volleys of balls, and the Buddha palm finale at the end
    Powerup
    Powerup class is an abstract class/ base class for every powerup a player can roll (3 possible powerups in total) It's abstract because each powerup does something different when it activates so SizePowerup, SpeedPowerup and SlowPowerup each write their own activate()
    PowerupRoll
    Added a slot-machine roll that picks a random powerup for one player The highlight moves through the powerup names, traverse through the powerup names and make each bright then dim, slows to a stop on one, and gives the powerup to the player awarded
    SizePowerup
    Makes the player's paddle taller for a period of time, so the player is easier to block the ball
    SlowPowerup
    Slows down the opponent's paddle for a period of time Only powerup that affects the other player instead of the one who rolled it
    SoundEffects
     
    SpeedPowerup
    Makes the player's paddle move faster for a period of time Boosting adds Paddle's SPEED_CHANGE dx to the normal speed.
    StartScreen
    This class shows a start screen with the title, a play button and the instructions paragraph undernearth
    Zetamac
    A Zetamac-style math duel.
